import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod1 = 998244353;
    static final int mod2 = 1000000007;
    static final int NN = 1000100;

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        int first;
        int second;

        public Pair(int first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return Integer.compare(first, o.first);
        }
    }

    static class FastReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }

        String nextLine() {
            String str = "";
            try {
                str = br.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return str;
        }
    }

    static FastReader sc = new FastReader();
    static PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

    static int[] L = new int[NN];
    static int[][] s = new int[7][NN];
    static int[] sum = new int[7];

    static int nxt(int val, int n) {
        if (val * 10 <= n) return val * 10;
        else {
            val++;
            while (val % 10 == 0) val /= 10;
            return val;
        }
    }

    static void pre() {
        int val = 0, len = 1, nth = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 1111110; i++) {
            s[0][len] = (nth - val) % mod1;
            nth++;
            if (len < 6) len++, val *= 10;
            else {
                val++;
                while (val % 10 == 0) val /= 10, len--;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < 7; i++) {
            Arrays.sort(s[i]);
            for (int v : s[i]) sum[i] = (sum[i] + v) % mod2;
        }

        int ed = 1, f = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 1000000; i++) {
            if (i == ed) ed *= 10, f++;
            L[i] = f;
        }
    }

    static int NTH;
    static int calc(int val, int nth, int n) {
        int ans = 0;
        int st = val / 100;
        st++;
        while (st % 10 == 0) st /= 10;
        while (val != st) {
            ans = (ans + (nth - val) % mod2) % mod2;
            nth++;
            val = nxt(val, n);
        }
        NTH = nth;
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        pre();

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        if (n < 10000000) {
            int ans = 0;
            int val = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                ans = (ans + (i - val) % mod2) % mod2;
                if (i == n) break;
                val = nxt(val, n);
            }
            out.println(ans);
            return;
        }

        int ans = 0;
        int val = 1, nth = 1;
        int N = n / 1000000;
        while (true) {
            ans = (ans + (nth - val) % mod2) % mod2;
            nth++;
            if (L[val] == L[N]) {
                if (val == N) {
                    ans = (ans + calc(val * 10, nth, n)) % mod2;
                    nth = NTH;
                    break;
                }
                int v = val;
                for (int i = 1; i < 7; i++) {
                    v *= 10;
                    int del = (nth - 1 - v) % mod1;
                    int N = Arrays.binarySearch(s[i], del);
                    if (N < 0) N = -N - 2;
                    N = N - s[i].length;
                    ans = (ans + sum[i] + N * mod1 % mod2) % mod2;
                    ans = (ans + mod2) % mod2;
                    ans = (ans + del * s[i].length % mod2) % mod2;
                }
                nth += 1111110;
            }
            val = nxt(val, n);
        }

        n = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < L[N] + 6; i++) n *= 10;
        n--;
        N = n / 1000000;

        val /= 10;
        val++;
        while (val % 10 == 0) val /= 10;

        while (val != 1) {
            ans = (ans + (nth - val) % mod2) % mod2;
            nth++;
            if (L[val] == L[N]) {
                int v = val;
                for (int i = 1; i < 7; i++) {
                    v *= 10;
                    int del = (nth - 1 - v) % mod1;
                    int N = Arrays.binarySearch(s[i], del);
                    if (N < 0) N = -N - 2;
                    N = N - s[i].length;
                    ans = (ans + sum[i] + N * mod1 % mod2) % mod2;
                    ans = (ans + mod2) % mod2;
                    ans = (ans + del * s[i].length % mod2) % mod2;
                }
                nth += 1111110;
            }
            val = nxt(val, n);
        }
        out.println(ans);
        out.close();
    }
}
